title: Dnyaneshwar and the Varkari saints
summary: From Nivruttinath and Dnyaneshwar at Alandi to Namdev, Chokhamela, Eknath and Tukaram: the saints of the Pandharpur wari, and the people outside it, from Guru Arjan to Ambedkar, whom they reached.

title: Samarth Ramdas and his disciples
summary: The Ramdasi sampradaya of Maharashtra: Kalyan Swami, Venabai and the maths Ramdas founded, Chhatrapati Shivaji as his best-known disciple, and the people the Dasbodh reached later.

title: Sri Ramakrishna and his disciples
summary: From the Kali temple at Dakshineswar to Vivekananda, the Ramakrishna Math and Mission, the Vedanta societies abroad, and the leaders and writers who said the teaching changed them.
